_about: The market call. Superman (CASE-026), investor profile 6, CHF 2.38m, comfortable with volatility and a long horizon. He loses CHF 30k and wants to know why. Lines and gaps are docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md, Call 1; every question was checked against POST /ask first.

lines.text: Morning. I've just seen the screens, how much did I lose today?
Right, but why? What actually drove it?
And am I breaking any of your rules at the moment?
Did anything at all hold up?
Fine. Send me the numbers and we'll talk at the review.
